title: 404: NO WAY OUT
design_note: Build 012 playable campaign: all 88 missions are retained and now have protagonist assignments, world targets, prototype steps, prerequisites, scoring and consequence contracts. M01 is the canonical opening: airport arrival, cab, Cole family house, first lead. M32-M34 are mid/late campaign arcs; M86-M88 are the true final choice, aftermath and post-game epilogue.
